unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 11 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.3 - THEME 3: PERSONAL LIFE & WELL-BEING

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will research the progress and change in education by comparing traditional and modern methods, addressing challenges in today’s school systems, and examining the impact of technology. They will research key aspects, such as the role of digital tools and issues such as rising costs. They will present the findings creatively through timelines, videos, and/or interviews by covering the differences and transformations in education. Additionally, students will write a one-page reflection discussing how technology has improved education, other remaining challenges, and their preference between traditional and today’s modern technology-based systems. They will present it in the classroom. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as dietary practices and trends; the impact of social media on self-esteem and body image; managing screen time and digital detox for personal well-being'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school may know what comparing traditional and modern education; education challenges in today's world; impact of technology on education; national days and celebrations mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''school life and education'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as dietary practices and trends; the impact of social media on self-esteem and body image; managing screen time and digital detox for personal well-being'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/ or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about the impact of social media on self-esteem and body image; managing screen time and digital detox for personal well-being in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Designing a Workshop Plan Students design a workshop to educate peers about managing social media’s impact on self-esteem by using some listed vocabulary. Students write a workshop outline with sections such as: Understanding Social Media Portrayals: How do they change perception? Managing Exposure: Mindful strategies to reduce pressure. Building Self-esteem: Using constructive feedback to improve confidence. Students present their plans to the class and the teacher gives feedback on the use of the language with target vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To describe challenges in education in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Educational Challenges in the Today’s World Students watch a simple video provided by the teacher about problems in education such as ''quality of education'' and ''access to education''. After the video, they write simple sentences such as ''Social problems makes education harder'' or ''Globalisation is a big challenge'', by using target vocabulary such as ''challenging'' and ''rising education cost''. Later, each student reads her/his sentences aloud and peers provide corrections or suggestions if needed. The teacher gives constructive and supportive feedback on the use of language with the target vocabulary and grammar. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
